ImageServiceImageUpdateBody.description:
ImageCreateOrUpdateRequest is used for both creating and updating
an Image.

For create:
- id is omitted
- creation fields are provided

For update:
- id is provided
- only fields that need to be updated are provided.

imageAspectRatio.description:
AspectRatio represents standard visual aspect ratio classifications.

 - ASPECT_RATIO_16_9_LANDSCAPE: 16:9 Landscape - Primary widescreen format (Recommended 1920x1080)
 - ASPECT_RATIO_1_1_SQUARE: 1:1 Square (Recommended 1080x1080)
 - ASPECT_RATIO_32_9_ULTRA_WIDE: 32:9 Ultra-Wide (OTT)
 - ASPECT_RATIO_3_4_PORTRAIT: 3:4 Portrait
 - ASPECT_RATIO_9_16_VERTICAL: 9:16 Vertical
 - ASPECT_RATIO_2_3_PORTRAIT: 2:3 Portrait
